why: From A to B the frame shape and the middle shape swap: the inner square becomes the big circle and the circle becomes the inner square, and all the little shapes stand in one straight line. In C the trapezoid and the triangle must swap, so the answer has a big triangle with a trapezoid inside and little trapezoids and triangles in one column. Option 4 fits. Option 5 still has the trapezoid outside, so nothing swapped.
trick: Name each layer (outer, middle, inner) for A and B first, then see which layers changed places.
note: Small inner pieces are tiny in the scan; drawn as small triangles/trapezoids. In option 4 the bottom small piece looks like a triangle (a perfect copy of B's pattern would have a trapezoid there); book answer 4 used.
